sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa, Public holidays calendar (2025, 2026, 2027)
sources.said: Samoa's gazetted public holidays for 2025, 2026 and 2027, as published by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour under the Public Holidays Act 2008 ... the Monday observance where a gazetted date falls on a Sunday. 2026: New Year's Day Thursday 1 January; Day after New Year's Day Friday 2 January; Good Friday 3 April; Day after Good Friday Saturday 4 April (Saturday after Good Friday); Easter Monday 6 April; Mother's Day Monday 11 May (Monday after 2nd Sunday in May); Independence Day Monday 1 June; Father's Day Monday 10 August (Monday after 2nd Sunday in August); White Sunday (Lotu-a-Tamaiti) Monday 12 October (Monday after 2nd Sunday in October); Christmas Day Friday 25 December; Boxing Day Saturday 26 December. 2027: ... Independence Day Tuesday 1 June; ... Christmas Day Saturday 25 December; Boxing Day Sunday 26 December, Observed: Monday 27 December 2027. 2025: Independence Day Sunday 1 June, Observed: Monday 2 June. Other gazetted holidays: General Election 2025, 28 – 29 August 2025.
